cases.finding: With tool use and dynamic loading enabled, every observed initial provider request exposed exactly tavo_tool_search, tavo_ask_user, and tavo_web_fetch.
With dynamic loading disabled, the initial provider request exposed 59 callable tools: the 58 named Tavo catalog tools plus web_fetch, with no tool-search tool.
After re-enabling dynamic loading, the initial request returned to the exact three-tool discovery surface.
The real model discovered and called built-in tools for variables, input, chat/messages, characters, personas, lorebooks, regexes, presets, and memory in isolated test state.
tavo_ask_user produced the native confirmation dialog and tavo_web_fetch completed through the native loop; transient dialog/provider failures are not promoted as reliability guarantees.
Dry run did not persist, ordered appends accumulated, repeated clientRequestId was idempotent, stale expectedRevision failed without mutation, and cleanup restored the original disabled empty state.
tavo_message_insert is absent. Supplying message.index to tavo_message_append did not insert in the middle; the message appended at the end.
A localized minimal spec-2 package validated, packaged, installed, enabled, exposed a native input action, wrote the exact marker, disabled cleanly, and was retained disabled.

A provider disconnect before the first tool call was followed by a user-tapped Retry that started a fresh initial round and then completed a direct tool call. This does not prove automatic or mid-loop resume.

nonPromotion: The 1.0 overlay does not re-prove every 0.93 feature.
Provider or gateway success does not prove Tavo retry reliability.
Tool schemas shown to the model do not prove every tool's semantics.
External MCP and the in-chat Agent Loop are distinct surfaces even when names overlap.
